findings.defect: The draft makes this a claim about the Prophet acting with others. The thought instead qualifies Michael Silbert’s rise: it was not achieved through his abilities alone.
findings.rationale: The following sentence attributes Michael’s position to the Muninns who served him.
findings.replacement: *Michael Silbert hadn’t done it on his own.*

findings.current: *But now I have all of it.*
findings.defect: The draft gives Michael’s hidden resources to the narrator instead of the Prophet.
findings.rationale: The next lines describe Muninn forming a new power base and inheriting what his dead master concealed.
findings.replacement: *But now the Prophet had all of it.*
findings.source: ‘하지만 이제는 그 모든 걸 갖게 됐지.’

findings.current: Probably a concussion at the very least, but I’d dumped a potion all over him, too. He’d be fine.
findings.defect: The draft adds a deliberate action by the narrator. Huginn was drenched when the potion bottle broke on his head.
findings.rationale: The source states the resulting condition, not that Jin separately poured potion over Huginn.
findings.replacement: Probably a concussion at the very least, but he’d been drenched in potion, too. He’d be fine.
findings.source: 최소 뇌진탕이긴 한데, 뭐 포션도 뒤집어썼으니까 괜찮겠지.

findings.current: “More precisely, the first Muninn. The first and last one I ever saw.”
findings.defect: This says Huginn never saw any later Muninn, contradicting his account that he met three as an adult. He saw the first Muninn only once.
findings.rationale: 처음이자 마지막으로 봤던 refers to seeing that first Muninn, not to seeing Muninns altogether.
findings.replacement: “More precisely, the first Muninn. That was the first and last time I saw him.”
findings.source: “정확히는 첫 번째 무닌이었지. 처음이자 마지막으로 봤던.”

findings.current: A hidden blade that had secretly visited Michael Silbert every year or so—sometimes after a few years.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the usual interval: visits were ordinarily years apart, with one year the shorter interval.
findings.rationale: 보통은 수년에 한 번씩 establishes the norm; 짧게는 일 년 gives the minimum.
findings.replacement: A hidden blade that secretly visited Michael Silbert once every few years—sometimes after just one.
findings.source: 짧게는 일 년. 보통은 수년에 한 번씩 비밀리에 미카엘 실베르트를 찾아오는 숨겨진 검.

findings.defect: Square brackets around a System-panel quest title violate the specified panel format.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already identify the notice; UI terms should not retain square brackets.
findings.source: - 퀘스트, [알 수 없는 죽음]을 성공적으로 완료했습니다!

findings.current: You have obtained the special Item [Eyes of Truth]!
findings.defect: Square brackets around the System-panel item name violate the specified panel format.
findings.rationale: The item name can remain distinct without square brackets inside a framed System notice.
findings.replacement: You have obtained the special Item *Eyes of Truth*!

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but two passages assign actions or possessions to the wrong person, and several others alter concrete details.
